as_told.title: Kit Green confronts Eric Walker at Penn State about crashed saucers

plain: A man named Kit Green is said to have gone to see Eric A. Walker at Penn State, where Walker had been president, and to have been thrown out of his office when he asked about UFOs. The researcher Grant Cameron tells it to Michels second-hand. He draws on Forbidden Science, the published journals of the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée, and places the meeting in the 1980s. In Cameron's account, when Green raised the subject, "Walker just blew up and he started yelling at him." Walker told him he did not have to tell him anything. Michels mentions the same run-in between Green and Walker only in passing. The story is told because, if true, Walker reacted like a man guarding something he knew.
